column1: # Settings for importing the Delhi NCR metro from data/raw/delhi_overpass.json.
# Tab-separated. See include/metrograph/osm_import.hpp for the meaning of each key.
# OSM has no timetables, so every segment time is ESTIMATED as
# These are round-number assumptions, not measurements. They will be calibrated against the
# official DMRC journey planner when the verification table is built.
# Airport Express runs faster trains with long gaps between stations.
# OSM maps one stop position per line and direction; same-name positions this close are one station.
# Only official interchanges are listed. Many other stations are within walking distance of one
# another, but they are not signposted interchanges and are deliberately not linked.
# Time = walk_detour * straight-line distance / walk_speed_mps unless a time is given.
